note: Phase three, and only reachable at depth 1 or more. This is the one place he is allowed to say why he is doing the thing, because somebody asked. It is a reason, not a fact: a fact is true for everybody. The subject family is for a question about the world: the text is a stance he holds, not a fact he is reciting, and it arrives from decide/subject rather than from his own day. The point family is the only way the point of a story is ever spoken, and it is only reachable when the story has just been told and the question asked what it meant. The subject and point families carry a single variant on purpose: there is one honest way to state a stance and one way to state a point, and padding them with the same placeholder twice was variety on paper only.
